exp-r solo, portable retro gaming consol.name: EXP-R Solo, Portable Retro Gaming Console
exp-r solo, portable retro gaming consol.description: The Evercade EXP-R Solo is the newest version of the award-winning retro gaming console. This new variant of the portable handheld console includes just the hardware on its own, and makes playing retro games on Evercade easier than ever. The new Evercade EXP-R Solo handheld has a new retro-inspired colour scheme, is built to be played on the go, and has full Evercade cartridge compatibility. Take arcade, console, and home computer gaming wherever you are with over 600 games across 60+ physical Evercade cartridge collections. The Evercade EXP-R Solo also has a high-resolution IPS screen for greater viewing angles and better quality, built-in WiFi for easy updates, and the TATE mode makes vertical gaming seamless and comfortable with its dedicated buttons. It also supports the entire Evercade cartridge library. Whether you're revisiting a childhood favourite or discovering a decades-old genre for the first time, the growing Evercade library spans arcade, home computer, and console gaming across six decades, with new officially licensed cartridge collections released regularly. Its retro-inspired colour scheme is designed to sit proudly alongside modern consoles on a media shelf while staying true to the look and feel of classic gaming hardware. For anyone building a retro gaming setup, it's a straightforward way to add licensed arcade, home computer, and console gaming to handheld sessions without hunting down original hardware. Blaze Entertainment tunes the emulation for each supported title individually, aiming for the original look, speed, and feel of the source hardware rather than a generic catch-all emulator.

Descubre el Ka'bah, la estructura en forma de cubo en el centro de la Santa Mezquita, creído que había sido construido por Adán y luego reconstruido por Abraham y su hijo Ismael.
